title: SEC6: Test vectors from published external standards
description: All KATs use vectors from independent published sources: NIST FIPS 180-4 (SHA-256 empty string), NIST SP 800-38A F.2.1 (AES-CBC-128 block 1), NIST SP 800-38D Test Case 1 (AES-GCM empty plaintext), RFC 4231 Test Cases 1, 2, and 3 (HMAC-SHA256). No vector is derived from the code under test. For ECDSA where no deterministic KAT is available without a fixed k, a sign+verify round-trip is used with a freshly generated key — this is the standard practice for randomized signature schemes, and the test comment correctly explains why. This satisfies the project's test-vector discipline requirement.
